regulator_sources.observed_state: Current list exposes umbrella/unit trust schemes and nested sub-funds; some products are explicitly KES/USD/EUR/GBP.
2026 approvals confirm continued creation of umbrella schemes and multi-currency/multi-asset sub-funds.

canonical_identity_implication.scheme: Needs a stable scheme/umbrella identity when regulator groups products.
canonical_identity_implication.subfund: Explicitly required: regulator list names sub-funds inside schemes.
canonical_identity_implication.shareclass: Must not be inferred blindly from currency, but multi-currency variants make class/grain verification mandatory.
canonical_identity_implication.manager: Manager relationship comes from regulator/official scheme context where available.
canonical_identity_implication.currency: Treat currency as explicit attribute of sub-fund/class source, never name-only inference.

acquisition_plan_candidate: Parse official CMA scheme list into regulator-universe snapshots with acquisition date and source URL.
Preserve scheme heading and nested sub-fund text rather than flattening everything to one fund row.
For each manager/scheme, locate official NAV/unit-price/factsheet publication path.
Classify NAV source as regulator-hosted, manager-hosted, administrator-hosted or unavailable.
Measure publication cadence, history depth, currency, unit-price semantics, document lineage and terms of reuse.
Only after five representative managers pass source tests design a reusable Kenya adapter.
blockers: No centralized official daily NAV endpoint certified yet.
No canonical AfricaFunds SubFund/ShareClass schema decision yet.
No source licence/redistribution review for manager-hosted price data yet.

proven_examples.finding: Public product pages expose currency, benchmark, trustee/custodian, manager and current fund terms; downloadable factsheets are available.
Public product catalogue confirms daily liquidity/compounding and KES/USD fund variants, but no centralized public historical unit-price feed was certified.
Official product/factsheet surfaces exist; centralized machine-readable historical NAV feed remains unproven.

nav_source_sampling.conclusion: Manager-hosted fund/factsheet data is clearly available, but a stable daily unit-price/NAV acquisition surface has not yet been certified across representative managers.
nav_source_sampling.remaining: Continue manager-by-manager source feasibility; do not equate yield/factsheet publication with NAV time series.

regulator_sources.observed_state: Official list exposes fund name, website, fund manager and custodian/trustee.
Official list exposes unit trust identity, website, fund manager and custodian/trustee.
SEC explains NAV per share and bid/offer reporting for open-ended collective investment schemes.

canonical_identity_implication.service_provider: Custodian/trustee is explicit and should map to Organization/service-provider semantics, not remain a duplicated free-text copy long term.
canonical_identity_implication.price_semantics: NAVPS, bid and offer are distinct concepts and must retain explicit price_type.

acquisition_plan_candidate: Snapshot regulator Mutual Fund and Unit Trust registries separately and preserve legal scheme type.
Resolve manager/custodian entities through canonical Organization aliases.
Sample at least five managers covering mutual funds and unit trusts to locate official NAVPS/bid/offer feeds.
Record whether price history is HTML, downloadable file, factsheet/report or API and whether historical depth is sufficient.
Use annual regulator reports only as validation/coverage evidence, not as a substitute for daily/periodic NAV time series.
Design Ghana adapter only after source semantics and publication cadence are certified.
blockers: No centralized current fund-level daily NAV feed certified yet.
Fund-manager website heterogeneity likely requires source adapters.
NAVPS vs bid/offer selection must be explicit and quality-reviewed.

proven_examples.finding: Public current fund values are displayed with explicit GHS/GHC currency and as-of dates for multiple Ghana funds.

nav_source_sampling.conclusion: At least one large licensed manager exposes a stable public price surface. This proves Ghana NAV-source feasibility for a pilot, not full-market coverage.
nav_source_sampling.remaining: Sample at least four additional licensed managers before designing a market-wide adapter.

shared_P1_acceptance_before_connector_ta: Regulator universe snapshot can be reproduced deterministically.
Fund/SubFund/ShareClass grain is explicit and source-backed.
At least five representative managers/products have a stable official NAV/price publication path OR the absence of such path is explicitly documented.
Price type and currency are explicit.
Raw/source evidence can fit the W2 ingestion contract.
No dependency requires inventing identifiers, NAV, benchmark or provenance.
A pilot manager feed does not authorize claiming full-market coverage.
next_action: Ghana: sample four additional licensed managers for dated public fund prices and source stability. Kenya: continue NAV-source feasibility across at least five representative managers while preserving regulator scheme/sub-fund hierarchy. No connector task until acceptance criteria are met.
